record_nav_target: record the current robot pose as a navigation target in the waypoints yaml file
record_clutter_target: record the current robot pose as a clutter target and add it to the clutter list
record_place_target: record the current gripper position as a place target for object placement in the yaml file
read_write_yaml: read and write waypoint data to a yaml file using the YamlHandler class methods
create_waypoints_file: create a new waypoints yaml file with default targets using the create file flag
